description: This Java source file contains performance tests for the Connection Pool configuration of a Fineract client, using WireMock to simulate server responses and JUnit for testing. It defines the class ConnectionPoolPerformanceTest with multiple test methods to evaluate connection pooling behavior under different scenarios.

classes.name: ConnectionPoolPerformanceTest
classes.description: A JUnit test class for evaluating the connection pool behavior of a Fineract client under various conditions.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes and starts the WireMock server before each test.

methods.name: tearDown
methods.description: Stops the WireMock server after each test.

methods.name: testConnectionPoolTTL
methods.description: Verifies connection reuse and renewal based on the connection time-to-live setting with a delay to test expiry.

methods.name: testConnectionPoolTTLWithMultipleRequests
methods.description: Tests repeated requests with a short TTL to ensure connections are periodically refreshed.

methods.name: testConcurrentRequests
methods.description: Checks concurrent request handling with fixed thread pool and delays, asserting total duration.

methods.name: testConcurrentRequestsWithHighLoad
methods.description: Performs a high load test with many requests and concurrency, verifying all complete successfully within time constraints.

methods.name: testConnectionRecycling
methods.description: Assesses connection recycling by requesting repeatedly with a short TTL, with delays to force renewal.

methods.name: testDefaultConnectionTimeToLive
methods.description: Tests the default behavior without explicit TTL settings.

methods.name: testSequentialRequests
methods.description: Sends multiple sequential requests to evaluate overall latency.

methods.name: testConnectionPoolWithDifferentEndpoints
methods.description: Tests how the client handles multiple different endpoints and connection reuse across them.
